definitions.explanation: The highest level of professional baseball in North America, consisting of the American League and National League.

examples.japanese: MLB⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese players who are active in MLB.

notes:
MLB stands for 'Major League Baseball.' It is often called ⟦{大|だい}リーグ→大リーグ：17893_dairiigu⟧ or ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧ in Japanese.
